findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 21 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 18 questions numbered 1-18; by section: u-introduction-halothane-classification 2, 21.1 2, 21.2 1, 21.3 1, 21.3.1 5, 21.3.2 3, 21.4 3, 21.5 1.

Theory parts cover classification, uses, preparation methods and their reasons, reactivity and bond energies, SN and E reactions, SN2, SN1, carbocation stability, β-elimination, E2, E1, the NaOH competition, the ammonia series, the silver nitrate test and halogenoarenes. Numericals (SN2, SN1 and E2 rate laws) use values stated in the questions, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed (bromomethane, HFCs, [(C₂H₅)₄N]⁺Br⁻ N,N,N-triethylethanaminium bromide).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
